$comment:
Deliberately NOT covered by this schema (handled by spec-lint.mjs at runtime):
  1. summary-length: ≤25-word limit — JSON Schema has no word-count keyword.
  2. origin_rfc referential integrity: whether the value resolves to a real RFC file on disk.
  3. superseded_by referential integrity: whether the target node exists.
  4. snapshot_of referential integrity: whether the referenced snapshot exists.
  5. parent-agrees-with-directory-path: the parent field value must match the concept's containing directory path.
The origin_rfc 'null' sentinel (literal string "null") IS rejected here via not:{const:"null"}.

id.description: Concept node identifier; matches RFC §2.2 pattern C-<SEGMENT>(-<SEGMENT>)*

summary.description: ≤25 words enforced by spec-lint.mjs, not this schema

parent.description: Parent concept id, or null for the root concept (C-GROUNDWORK)

origin_rfc.description: RFC uid that introduced this node; literal string 'null' is rejected here
